data.title: Events are append-only: nothing is edited or deleted, and task delete writes a task.deleted event
data.why: From CLAUDE.md, as written there: events are append-only, nothing is edited or deleted. task delete writes a task.deleted event and the message says so plainly, because promising erasure in an append-only journal would be a lie. To correct the state, add a new event through the CLI; files under .kadence/events are never hand-edited.
data.rejected: A delete that erases the event: the message would promise an erasure the journal cannot keep
